name: Nanaho Hoemi
source:
2nd year student at Cherry Tree High and friends with Miley since junior high. Harriet lives at the Unity Dormitory and is a close friend of Miley, despite being dragged into her capers and forced to help her out in various ways. She is kind, likes to help people and is popular with all the guys and girls who know her. Harriet works part time in the downtown cafe ‘Loco Moco’.

From [url=http://cherrytreehigh.com/characters/]Official website[/url]
